name: loquein-site
description: loquein.com landing page: static site served by a Cloudflare Worker

scripts.check:deploy: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --local-protocol https
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run check:links && npm run check:html && npm run check:deploy && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
